text: nandivisālasuttaṃ [301] ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho nandivisālo devaputto bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi catucakkaṃ navadvāraṃ puṇṇaṃ lobhena saṃyutaṃ paṅkajātaṃ mahāvīra kathaṃ yātrā bhavissatīti . [302] chetvā naddhiṃ varattañca icchālobhañca pāpakaṃ samūlaṃ taṇhaṃ abbuyha evaṃ yātrā bhavissatīti . navamaṃ
